title: Super-brain2 Canonical MCP Tools v2 Contract

prepare_task.description: Prepare a workspace-bound task delivery with bounded snapshot observation and holdout assignment.

search_knowledge.description: Search workspace-eligible knowledge artifacts without invoking external providers.

get_artifact.description: Read an artifact at level L0/L1/L2 and record a server-side send attempt.

submit_episode.description: Record agent-reported task evidence, optional candidate lesson, and declared read acknowledgments.

record_outcome.description: Record a declared task delivery outcome together with applied refs and declared read acknowledgments.

request_improvement.description: Enqueue an asynchronous reflection/improvement job for a workspace task.

get_job.description: Read the current state, attempt count, typed result refs, and accounting status of an authorized job.

get_health.description: Read fast shallow daemon health or trigger/inspect deep doctor status.
